set.known_text: اس پیلی لکیر کی دوسری طرف
set.target_text: other side of that yellow line

L01.why: S3: 'side' is in the seed ('It's on the other side of that yellow line') and no LEGO carries it; L01 'line' is the seed's only LEGO. The shortest piece that holds both 'side' and 'line' with an honest Urdu side is 'other side of that yellow line' (8 syllables, at the cap; with 'the' it would be 9).

on the other side of that yellow line

notes: cs #813: re-cut: 'line' -> 'other side of that yellow line'. U01 (the seed sentence) already contains it. THE WEAKEST TRADE IN THIS SET, for Kai to weigh: a one-word LEGO with a varied basket becomes an 8-syllable LEGO with nine near-identical long rows. A separate LEGO for 'the other side of' would be far better but needs Kai's key; dropping this file leaves S0488 as it is.
